snippet.title: Radio Rain - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Moody lofi beats meet playful platform adventuring in a ruined, rainy world! Search rain-spattered streets, take on an army of mischievous creatures, and work together with your spirit companion to find a way home. Currently in development with the proud support of Team Cherry Presents.

Watch the creator introduction: https://youtu.be/T30-deLn28M
Wishlist on Steam: https://radioraingame.com/
